name: Cheddar, Apple & Onion Quesadilla with Arugula-Radish Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 Granny Smith apples
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice onions into half-moons.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and golden brown, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, quarter and core apples, then thinly slice.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide onion, apple, and cheese between them, arranging the filling on one half of each tortilla; fold in half to close.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add quesadillas and cook until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden, 2½-3 minutes per side. Remove to a large plate.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
